cards.card_text: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death, but a ___ man will pacify it.
cards.verse_text: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
cards.snippet: …a king is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

cards.card_text: In the same line, Solomon says a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
cards.verse_text: A gift in secret soothes anger, and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
cards.snippet: A gift in secret soothes anger, and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
